The Story

You notice the pack before you read a word.

Matte black. Neon green. A monkey with X eyes and a crown, staring off every bag and jar. Gas Monkey doesn't whisper from the shelf, you spot the face first, and the name lands after.

The Bag

The flagship. Matte black pouch with the green camo seal up top and a clear window up front, so the flower speaks for itself.

  • Finish Matte black
  • Detail Green camo seal
  • Front Flower window

The Jar

Glass, heavy, and clean. Black lid wrapped in the green camo band, full label art, flower sealed fresh inside.

  • Body Glass jar
  • Lid Black, camo band
  • Label Full wrap art

The Story

So what's inside a pack that looks like that?

Plenty of flower looks the part. A loud pack raises an honest question: does what's inside earn the face on the front? That question is the whole brand, and it gets answered one small batch at a time.

The Lineup

Small batches. Exotic genetics. Nothing carries the monkey unless it earns it.

No mass runs, no shortcuts, no common flower wearing a loud label. The lineup rotates in small batches. When a run is gone, it's gone. These are the names moving under the monkey right now.

The Story

Born in Richmond. Raised on quality.

The name says it all. Gas is the standard: loud, top shelf flower. Monkey is the attitude: street born, graffiti marked, impossible to ignore. RVA is home, and home is on every pack.

01

Small Batch Only

Limited runs, hands on every step. Small batches mean every pack gets checked, not just shipped.

02

Exotic Genetics

Strains chosen for character: the nose, the look, the cure. If it's common, it's not Gas Monkey.

03

Richmond Roots

RVA isn't a marketing line, it's home. The city is in the name, on the pack, and behind everything the brand does.

04

The Culture

Street luxury. Graffiti energy with a premium finish. The monkey with the X eyes is a mark people rep, not just a logo they read.
